# Apex Agents
> AI lead scouting, 9-signal scoring, and personalized outreach for local service businesses. Built in Indianapolis.

## Key pages
- [How it works](https://apex-ai-agent.com/how-it-works): scout, score on 9 signals (Google rating, review volume, review recency, owner response rate, listing completeness, website presence, local SEO gaps, niche fit, opportunity window), draft outreach, owner approves, publisher sends.
- [Pricing](https://apex-ai-agent.com/pricing): 3-day free trial tier (100 AI messages; no credit card), Premium $29/mo, Pro $99/mo.
- [Sign up](https://apex-ai-agent.com/signup)

## Blog
- [Blog index](https://apex-ai-agent.com/blog): practical guides for Indianapolis-area service businesses on winning commercial customers.
- [How to Get Commercial HVAC Accounts in Indianapolis](https://apex-ai-agent.com/blog/how-to-get-commercial-hvac-accounts-indianapolis): choosing commercial buyers, vendor paperwork (COI, W-9, PM agreement), building a qualified list, outreach and CAN-SPAM basics, follow-up rhythm.
